blocking_rules: Do not call any paid API endpoint while money_ceiling is null.

Do not transmit document text to a hosted service unless a matching explicit authorization exists. Current exceptions: selected public paper passages for annotation in the Codex session (scoped_authorizations.codex_public_text_annotation) and in the Claude Code session for software link gold drafting (scoped_authorizations.claude_link_gold_annotation).
Do not report a newly initialized encoder head as a software extractor.
Do not convert model failures or empty responses into successful empty extractions.

codex_public_text_annotation.purpose: Software-mention annotation and evidence checking for the SciBERT POC
codex_public_text_annotation.allowed_data: Selected public paper passages acquired through permitted open sources

claude_link_gold_annotation.purpose: Draft paper-to-software entity links (mention -> registry entity or NIL) for resolver evaluation; evidence checking
claude_link_gold_annotation.allowed_data: Openly licensed SoFAIR v2 papers and open-access OpenAlex lockbox papers; mention contexts only as needed
claude_link_gold_annotation.human_review: Maintainer spot-checks a sample; drafts are provisional until reviewed
